field: Daily raw close, volume, adjusted close, split events, dividend events
scope: SPY, QQQ, theme anchors, parent ETFs, reviewed stocks, anchor alternatives
method: HTTPS JSON chart endpoint via stdlib urllib; 1-day interval, events=div,splits, includeAdjustedClose=true; sequential requests spaced 1.5 seconds apart to reduce throttling
history_or_as_of: 60 symbols; 503–503 daily bars, source span 2024-10-21 to 2026-10-22
delay_and_availability: Daily bars; the current session is accepted only after 16:30 America/New_York and a same-date provider market timestamp. Otherwise the prior completed session is used. No guaranteed publication delay.
limitations: Endpoint is undocumented. Provider adjustment and publication semantics can change. It is not an exchange feed or a licensed data guarantee.
fallback: Query2 uses the same Yahoo schema and adjustment convention. Hosts stop receiving requests after HTTP 429. If retrieval still fails, publication is rejected and a last successful export is retained with its original date.
last_test: 60/60 requested chart series retrieved; 0 error(s).

field: Shared US-session calendar and completed-session date
scope: Selected reference SPY; benchmark remains SPY
method: Use SPY session dates when available; otherwise QQQ, then the first available configured ETF anchor. SPY benchmark returns are never substituted.
delay_and_availability: Same-date bar is treated as final only after the 16:30 New York cutoff and a provider regular-market timestamp on that date.
limitations: If SPY is unavailable, other price returns can remain valid but SPY-relative excess is unavailable. A fallback calendar does not replace the benchmark.
fallback: No forward-fill or inferred sessions. If no ETF calendar is retrieved, session-dependent values stay unavailable.
last_test: Reference SPY retrieved.

field: Market capitalization, listing exchange, sector, industry
method: HTTPS JSON summary response; MarketCap, Exchange, Sector, Industry
history_or_as_of: Current quote-summary retrieval on this run; per-field observation date is not supplied by provider.
delay_and_availability: On-demand retrieval; the source publishes no separate cap-field timestamp or guaranteed refresh delay.
limitations: A current summary response does not prove the market-cap field itself is no older than 35 days. Such values are provisional and timestamp uncertainty is shown.
fallback: None. Missing cap, exchange, or industry blocks provisional stock eligibility.
last_test: 204 ticker summaries retrieved; 0 error(s).
